title: SREV-014 FSCTL_PIPE_WAIT buffer shape

fscc_wire_layout.description: MS-FSCC FSCTL_PIPE_WAIT request: Timeout(8 bytes), NameLength(4 bytes, size in bytes of Name), TimeoutSpecified(1 byte), Padding(1 byte), Name(variable Unicode string without the \pipe\ prefix)

smb2_failure_modes.description: Malformed names fail as not found; non-pipe objects fail as invalid device request; timeout expiration fails as timeout

input_validation_owner.description: File_WaitNamedPipe rejects InputBuffer==NULL, InputBufferLength < FIELD_OFFSET(...,Name), NameLength not WCHAR-aligned, NameLength > InputBufferLength - name_offset before any field read

name_len_invariant.description: name_len = NameLength / sizeof(WCHAR) must satisfy name_len + Dll_BoxIpcPathLen + 64 <= (ULONG)-1 / sizeof(WCHAR) before allocating the output buffer

alloc_invariant.description: Output buffer allocated via Dll_AllocTemp(buf_len); allocation failure returns STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES before any write

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: malformed FSCTL_PIPE_WAIT payloads fail closed; normal WaitNamedPipe still works

contracts: InputBuffer must be non-null and InputBufferLength must cover FIELD_OFFSET(FILE_PIPE_WAIT_FOR_BUFFER, Name) before NameLength is read
NameLength must fit inside InputBufferLength minus the Name field offset
Rewritten output allocation is checked before any write
Hook validates the subset of the FSCTL payload it dereferences; native validation still owns the rest
